neutral_component_scope: Start with the map-named module, library entry file, adjacent iterator-named file, and matching test filename. This is a filename-based boundary, not an established API/caller closure.

scope_limits.closure: Confirm actual declarations, immediate callers/helpers, dependency and feature boundaries later; document unresolved closure rather than expanding indefinitely.

goal: Later bounded source-grounded verification/specification assessment of this filename-defined library slice; actionable handoff or no-new-work without predetermined properties.
adoption: Read-only planning only; no target production changes or execution without separate actual owner grants and applicable isolation.

provenance.license_interpretation: Apache-2.0 is the primary API identification and inspected license. An additional MIT text is present; the complete alternative-license expression was not established from implementation/package bodies.

uncertainties: Semantic version and supported version range not established.
Feature-dependent source selection, dependency closure, concurrency, FFI and deployment applicability unexamined.
Helper/caller relationships are filename leads, not observed calls.
Catalog membership, existing proof coverage, customer value and assessment outcome unexamined.
identity_basis: Pinned Git commit/tree plus independently clean working tree and tracked object inventory; not a SHA-256 digest of every working-tree file
